# IoT Core

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/iot@v1.84.4` · last audited 2026-10-12 (`22b4f068c`)

## Coverage

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| PARITY entries audited | 88 (88 ok) |
| Feature families | 21 (21 ok) |

| Deferred items | 0 |
| Resource leaks | found_and_fixed |

### Known gaps

- Jobs and broker authentication: notification de-duplication is not modelled; HTTP-protocol custom authorizers (iotdataplane Publish with x-amz-customauthorizer-name/-signature headers) are not wired because services/iotdataplane/handler_publish.go has no authentication seam and no reference to the iot backend's InvokeAuthorizer (authorizer_invoke.go:121); WebSocket (WSS) authentication is not modelled because the broker serves no WebSocket listener (broker.go).
- $aws/events: CA_CERTIFICATE just-in-time registration (`$aws/events/certificates/registered/<caCertificateId>`) is not produced because the broker does not register an unknown client certificate on connect (a certificate must already be registered and ACTIVE); lifecycle events omit `thingName` and never reset `versionNumber` after an hour offline; connect_failed is published only after the TLS handshake, not for a rejected certificate; registry events omit thing type `propagatingAttributes` (not stored) and publish no JOB `deletion_in_progress`/`cancellation_in_progress` or JOB_EXECUTION `removed`.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- ListMetricValues.DimensionName and DimensionValueOperator are not applied: no device reports metrics, datapoints are only seeded internally and carry no dimension.
- DeleteOTAUpdate.DeleteStream is not honored: CreateOTAUpdate never creates an OTA-owned stream (needs a real OTA stream pipeline); ForceDeleteAWSJob is honored.
- Device-fleet-dependent fields (no connection tracking): GetThingConnectivityData IncludeSocketInformation, Job IsConcurrent/ThingGroupId, TopicRuleDestination StatusReason.
- Rule actions timestream, kafka, location, openSearch, iotEvents, iotSiteWise, influxDB are stored verbatim but not executed (no data-plane backend); http enableBatching/batchConfig and errorAction cloudwatchTraceId/clientId are not modeled.
